cells.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[2]))
def dominated(c, others):
    for o in others:
        if o is c: continue
        if o[1] >= c[1] and o[2] <= c[2] and (o[1] > c[1] or o[2] < c[2]): return True
    return False
